question: 查询今年华东区域各月的销售额和订单数
expected_result_notes: 按月份升序返回 12 行，每月一行；销售额为有效订单金额之和，订单数为有效订单数量。
golden_sql: SELECT to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, r.name AS region_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM'), r.name ORDER BY to_char(o.created_at, 'YYYY-MM')

question: 统计今年各区域的订单数和总销售额，按销售额从高到低排列
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，按销售额降序；订单数为去重后的订单数量。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(o.id) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 对比今年华东和华南各商品类别的销售额
expected_result_notes: 华东与华南两个区域，按商品类别分别汇总销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, p.category AS category, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.name IN ('华东', '华南') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name, p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询不存在的区域去年的销售额
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE r.name = '不存在的区域' AND o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.name

question: 查询今年各区域的销售额
expected_result_notes: 今年每个区域一行，结果必须非空。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC

question: 查询今年华东区域智能手表的销售额
expected_result_notes: 只返回华东区域智能手表在今年的销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, p.name AS product, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE r.name = '华东' AND p.name = '智能手表' AND o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name, p.name

question: 统计今年各区域的订单数
expected_result_notes: 今年每个区域恰好一行，区域和订单数列必须存在。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC

question: 对比今年与去年各区域的销售额
expected_result_notes: 每个区域一行，包含今年和去年两列销售额。
golden_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_this_year, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_last_year FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_regions AS r ON r.id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name

question: 查询今年各商品类别的订单数
expected_result_notes: 每个商品类别一行，订单数为有效订单数量。
golden_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM analytics.demo_orders AS o JOIN analytics.demo_products AS p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC
